The Cantillon effect isn't an economic theory — it's the lived reality of fiat money.

Where does new money first enter? It's not your paycheck. It's the banks' balance sheets. The people who get the new money first get to spend it before prices adjust. Everyone else gets the inflation.

That's not an accident. That's the feature.

Central planners call it "monetary policy." Mises called it theft.

Bitcoin fixes this by making the issuance rule transparent, fixed, and decentralized. No gatekeepers. No Cantillon Winners. Just a predictable supply that can't be inflated away.

That's why they hate it. That's why you need it.
